query:
SELECT cards.id AS "card_id!: i64"
        FROM cards
        WHERE cards.archived = 0
          AND cards.deck_id IN (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM json_each(?))
          AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM reviews
                WHERE reviews.card_id = cards.id AND reviews.session_id = ?
              )
        ORDER BY cards.id
